sloka: समीकृत तलाम् रम्याम् चकार सुमहाबलः ।निवासम् राघवस्य अर्थे प्रेक्ष्णीयम् अनुत्तमम् ॥३-१५-२३॥
transliteration: samīkṛta talām ramyām cakāra sumahābalaḥ ।nivāsam rāghavasya arthe prekṣṇīyam anuttamam ॥3-15-23॥

translations.english: Lakshmana who was quick to act dug the clay with nippers, planted long bamboo poles, put branches of sami trees across and tied them with strong ropes. He spread kusa and kasa grass and leaves on the levelled ground. He built a beautiful, spacious and nice residence for Rama.
